title: Allows booth cards to wrap with width
goal: makes booth cards automatically wrap according to the available width and fill a full line on wide screens.
summary: repeat combined with auto-fit will arrange as many columns as possible according to the width of the container. minmax(160px, 1fr) allows each column to have at least 160px of space, and then divides the remaining space equally among the columns with cards.
tasks: Set grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)) for .stations, using the 12px spacing between cards.
Zoom preview width, check card will change from one column to two or three columns. On a wide screen the three cards should fill the entire row.

example.note: album container is 250px wide, two photos can be placed side by side. When the space becomes narrower, the photos will be arranged on the next row.

hint: When there is a whole column empty on the right side of the wide screen, check whether auto-fit is written as auto-fill. auto-fit will collapse empty columns so that existing cards fill the rows.
